title: Count detector unavailability only after recording the failed check
answers: Why does one scheduled AI detector check count as several failures?
Where should unavailable detector outcomes be counted?
Should a failed attempt count if a later retry succeeds?
body:
Symptom: Detector health metrics report several failures for one scheduled check, or both failure and success when a retry succeeds.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert is retried by Temporal, so incrementing unavailable there counts attempts instead of recorded outcomes.
Fix pattern: Re-raise unavailable errors for retry; increment unavailable in posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:record_failed_evaluation only after writing the errored check and checking its error code.
Constraints: Count only LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE failures that were actually recorded; skipped writes, including alerts disabled mid-check, and other error types must not increment unavailable.
applies: The unavailable outcome of posthog_insight_alerts_ai_detector_checks_total across Temporal retries and failure recording.
